water.level_provenance: display level (illustrative, not a measured water level): flat = 10th percentile of terrain inside the polygon + 0.05 m; local (long/tidal water) = 30th percentile of DTM within 120 m + 0.05 m. Blue = mapped water below that level (flat); grey-brown = parts of the mapped water area where the DTM is above the display level (likely exposed bank/mud at survey time), drawn on the terrain. DTM not modified.
